long_biography.plain_text:
Born into a fishing family, Wu Guangming worked as manager of two medical-equipment factories in Danyang, Jiangsu. In the 1990s, he and his father began the venture that became Yuyue, pairing practical manufacturing experience with a growing domestic market for healthcare equipment.

Under Wu's leadership, Yuyue expanded from its family beginnings into a broader medical-device manufacturer serving hospitals and households. He took the company public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2008, turning the enterprise into a substantial family-controlled group. That operating history, rather than inheritance of an established business, underpins the self-made character of his fortune.
